header.description: Character pipeline (FAM-04/05): frmMain RefreshAll run whole for a loaded character, then PopulateCharacterProfile
notes: Each case runs RefreshAll (cut from frmMain.frm, scenario key frm) and then PopulateCharacterProfile twice with bForceUseChar and bForceNoParty: attack kind 0 ('profile') and the backstab kind 4 with the current weapon ('profile_bs'); the profiles are the ByRef results in outputs['profile.refs'][0] and outputs['profile_bs.refs'][0] (lower-cased member names).

RefreshAll is cut after RefreshCombatHealingValues (list colours and the lair-info reset are display). CalcCharacterStats is cut before its GetDamageOutput line (stat 46, later cards) but keeps its out: section; its tool-tip text helpers, SetCharDefenseDescription, RefreshShops and the colour passes are recorded no-ops.

Controls: txtCharMaxStats(i).Tag holds the race stat floors (cmbGlobalRace_Click writes them), chkCharQuests(0..11), cmbCharQuestOpts(0..3), cmbEquip, lvItemManager rows, cmbCharBless; globals: nEquippedItem, char_StatAdjustments and the nGlobalAttack* choice. Class and race combos are one-entry lists with ListIndex 1 (ListIndex 0 is the '(none)' entry).
Event cascades (a .Text change re-running a Refresh*) are not modelled by the shim; each step runs once.
data holds the stock rows the cases use as field lists (items, spells) and all stock classes and races, for the Rust test.
